title: Activation Funnels & Signal-Driven SDK Adoption Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: create a repeatable operational playbook and experiment matrix to grow active SDK usage across Redwood products (JS, Python, Go). This ticket covers definition of activation signals, event instrumentation, experiment templates, success metrics, and a prioritized roadmap of experiments and docs/quickstart changes needed to lift conversion from install -> first successful inference call within 24 hours.

Scope:
- Define canonical "activation" and "success" signals across SDKs and quickstarts.
- Instrument telemetry and dashboards for signal monitoring.
- Author three experiment templates (onboarding flow, sample app scaffolding, in-repo quickstarts) and schedule A/B tests.
- Produce a dev-facing playbook (docs + checklist) for the Growth + DevX teams to run activation experiments autonomously.
- Identify engineering work needed (batching of onboarding emails, serverless sample app hosting, CI test harness) and hand off to ENG teams.
acceptance_criteria: Activation signal spec published and approved by ENG & DX: includes event names, attributes, and activation/retention definitions
Dashboards live: onboarding funnel (visitors -> installs -> first API call -> 24h retention) and experiment cohort comparison
Three experiment templates implemented with tracking hooks and runbook; first experiment launched in 2-week sprint
Playbook doc in Confluence + condensed checklist in Console (help center) for engineers and SEs
Baseline metrics recorded and KPIs (activated_projects, time_to_first_call, weekly_active_sdk_repos) instrumented
progress_updates: 2026-02-21: Kickoff with Growth, DevX, and SDK leads. Agreed canonical 'sdk.first_successful_inference' with attributes {sdk_name, version, sample_app}
2026-02-28: Instrumentation spec v0.2 drafted; ENG owners assigned (ENG-43210 to add events to JS and Python SDKs; ENG-43901 to add serverless sample app telemetry)
2026-03-03: Created dashboard stub in Looker; basic funnel (site visits -> repo clone -> npm install -> first API call) visible with synthetic data

2026-03-08: Experiment templates reviewed by Growth; agreed 3x priority experiments: (A) minimal friction quickstart, (B) pre-seeded token-onboarding, (C) sample app deployment via one-click. Scoped work to 2-week sprints
2026-03-10: Security review triage: pre-seeded tokens flagged; decided to implement token gating via ephemeral tokens for experiments (implementation ticket ENG-44567)
decisions: Adopt 'first_successful_inference' within 24h as the primary activation metric (covers both SDK and CLI quickstarts)
Use cohort windows of 7/14/28 days for retention analysis to align with Growth reporting
Ephemeral token approach approved for low-friction trials; permanent API keys not used in public quickstarts
Start with JS + Python SDKs (highest traffic) and add Go after measurement stabilization
blockers: ENG bandwidth: SDK owners have limited capacity until runtime-1.20 release; may delay event wiring
Data pipeline: events team needs a mapping layer for new SDK attributes before dashboards are accurate
Legal review for any sample-app analytics capturing customer identifiers (blocked until 2026-03-12 review)
next_steps: Finalize instrumentation spec and merge to SDK repos (owners ENG-43210, ENG-43901) by 2026-03-15
Wire ephemeral token service (ENG-44567) and validate security checklist by 2026-03-22
Run experiment A (minimal friction quickstart) as an internal pilot with 150 seats by 2026-03-28
Publish DevX playbook draft and checklist in Confluence; solicit feedback from Solutions and SEs
Define experiment analysis plan (metrics, statistical power, length) with Growth analytics
